svg.title: G2 of Interphase and Prophase
svg.desc: G2 has an intact nucleus, nucleolus, uncondensed duplicated chromatin and two centrosomes. Prophase has six duplicated chromosomes and an early spindle outside the nuclear envelope. Original unmeasured animal-cell schematics after lecture 06B source figures. Purple denotes chromosomes; yellow denotes microtubules and centrosomes. Counts of chromatin loops and spindle fibers are illustrative.
